CHARMM36 and OPLS force fields with standard TIP water models produce Aβ10-10 peptide conformations that are in the best agreement with experimental data.
the Aβ10- 40 conformations predicted with five force fields exhibit similar secondary structure propensities and differ in their tertiary interactions.
the conformational ensemble of Aβ10−40 peptide is force field dependent and CHARMM36 force fields with standard TIP4P model produces the best representation of the experimental data.

the conformational properties of the Aβ peptide.
the conformational ensemble of Aβ10−40 and the impact of the force field on its structure and dynamics.
the conformational ensemble of the Aβ10- 40 peptide, a model system for the amyloid-β protein, and its force field dependence.

CHARMM36 with standard TIP4P water model is the best force field for Aβ10-30 simulations.
